Sam: Heads-up EdgeBridge SI reported connector crashes on our marketplace AMI during containerd start. Need arch triage ASAP.

Rohit: Can you drop the agent logs and the AMI id?

Elena: Pasted from SI:
```
panic: failed to apply seccomp profile
containerd: task start: operation not permitted
kernel ver: 5.10.132-50
image: edgebridge/connector:1.4.2
```

Maya: Customer is on Azure marketplace, scheduled go-live Thu local time. SI is asking for a hotfix from us, they prefer minimal changes.

Rohit: Quick triage: this smells like a seccomp profile that uses newer prctl/syscall filters only available on >=5.15. Options: rebuild AMI with newer kernel, relax seccomp for that image (security risk), or ship a compatibility shim in the image.

Elena: We can add a compatibility launcher that conditionally disables the seccomp profile for this image and emits audit logs. Prototype drop-in:
```
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/bin/seccomp-toggle --image edgebridge/connector:1.4.2 --mode fallback
ExecStart=/usr/bin/containerd-shim ...
```
This keeps default policy unchanged for other tenants.

release-bot: Ticket created: INF-6421 - marketplace/edgebridge/seccomp-compatibility. CI pipeline marketplace/edgebridge/compat-fallback triggered (build 129).

Sam: We need architecture signoff from eng-platform and security before proposing to customer. Tagging @secops and @eng-platform for review.

Maya: I'll draft two customer paths: (A) quick mitigation using the compat launcher + rollback window (estimated 2-3 hours), (B) full AMI rebuild with kernel bump (24-48 hours). Which do we recommend?

Rohit: Recommend A for immediate go-live with strict audit and canary; follow up with B as durable fix. I'll own smoke tests post-cutover.

Elena: I'll add a canary route in Console: 5% traffic to compat variant, 95% to default. Will add trace flags to correlate failures.

Sam: Agreed. Note: do not enable fallback globally. Tenant config only. Maya, please include Exec/rollback steps and owner contacts in the customer note.

Maya: On it. ETA draft 60m.

Rohit: Running smoke check script locally now, will post results here.

release-bot: Canary policy created in staging: policy-id canary-ebb-77. Deployment to staging started.

Sam: Thanks team. Will loop in partnerships PM for customer comms and update the SI handoff doc.
